betaBanner: Co-Intelligence Circle is in early public beta.
betaDetail: Live translation is available today. Quality varies by language pair, and availability may change during improvements. If translation pauses, your circle continues in the original voices.

tooltips.participants: The participant limit includes you as host. Guests join free by link or six-digit room code.
tooltips.30-minute sessions: Each circle lasts up to 30 minutes. Hold more circles within your monthly participant-hours.
tooltips.Unlimited session length: Hold circles of any length, as often as your monthly participant-hours allow.
tooltips.participantHours: Add up each person's time in your circles. One person for an hour uses one participant-hour; eight people use eight. Larger circles cost more because each person receives everyone else's video.
tooltips.Recording & transcript export: Save circle video and export transcripts as text. Recordings are automatically deleted after a period of time to reduce server costs.
tooltips.Recording export: Save your circle as a video file. Recordings are automatically deleted after a period of time to reduce server costs.
tooltips.3 breakout rooms: Open up to three smaller rooms for group conversations, then bring everyone back to the main circle.
tooltips.3 facilitator seats: Each seat lets one facilitator host circles. Guests join free, and their time counts toward your monthly participant-hours.
